stock.description: SPT Energy Group Inc. operates as an investment holding company, delivering a comprehensive range of integrated oilfield services and manufacturing associated products. Its extensive global presence spans the People's Republic of China, Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan, Canada, Singapore, Indonesia, and the Middle East. The company organizes its service offerings into three core segments: Drilling, Well Completion, and Reservoir. Its Drilling division encompasses a wide array of solutions, including providing drilling and workover rigs, performing complex well workovers and fishing operations, and supplying cementing and drilling fluid services. SPT also deploys advanced drilling techniques such as rotary geosteering, vertical and horizontal drilling, sidetracking, underbalanced drilling, and fine-managed pressure drilling. In the Well Completion segment, SPT provides project design, specialized tools, and well enhancement services like stimulation and fracturing. The Reservoir segment focuses on scientific analysis, offering geology and oil reservoir research, dynamic monitoring, oil testing, and recovery technology, in addition to coiled tubing services and repairs for surface production equipment. Beyond these primary oilfield activities, SPT Energy Group is also involved in diverse ventures such as farming, trading, manufacturing, the promotion of technology and application services, and gas operations. Founded in 1993, the company is headquartered in Beijing, People's Republic of China.
